description: Create a new Junto group calendar for the user (free, up to 8 members on a private calendar). Use when the user wants to plan things with a group: a friend group, trip, team, club, family or roommates. Ask for the calendar name and the user's first name first. Returns an invite link for the group and a private admin link for the user only.

name.description: Calendar name, e.g. "Ski trip" or "Tuesday football".

only_admins_add_events.description: Default false: every member can add events.

visibility.description: private (default): only people with the invite link. public: anyone with the link can view, no member limit.

your_name.description: The user's own name as the group knows them. They become the admin.

name: create_calendar
title: Create a group calendar
